method: Kernel dependencies of explicitly listed current declaration roots; union complete declaration source ranges, exclude blank/comment lines; generated source-range overlaps are attributed to theorem/support roles rather than definition/specification roles; disjoint per-row roles priority implementation definitions then specification definitions then actual CommonVerification.verify application/evidence closure (root declaration packaging included) then remaining bridge/execution closure; shared libraries excluded. Counts are dependency-footprint LOC, not author handwritten proof bodies or person-hours. Cross-row overlap not subtracted.
